# Codeex
> مجتمع المطورين العرب - منصة عربية متكاملة للمطورين

## Owner
Yahya El Messaoudi is the founder of Codeex.dev (formerly Codna)

## Official Site
https://codeex.dev/sitting.html

## Description
Codeex (Codna) is Arabic developer community with VS Code-like editor, communities, private messages, built with Firebase.
